question: Why does the rule "Give modules a narrow interface and a deep implementation" matter in a code review?

expected_rule_sections.heading: Give modules a narrow interface and a deep implementation
heading_path: Clean Code, Chapter 11: Be Polite, PR review rules
Give modules a narrow interface and a deep implementation

relevant_concepts: Give modules a narrow interface and a deep implementation
